comment: Добрый дом: comfort+ visuals + utility panels. Logo: cover always + 2-3 inlines only, TOP-RIGHT pad. No Shakin.
utility_test: Inline must teach OR show lived-in comfort+ OR infographic utility. Pure decorative icon row = FAIL.
style_lock: High-key #FFFFFF, warm hospitality. ONE small official logo TOP-RIGHT on cover + 2-3 inlines only (factory paste). Cozy lived-in, NOT hotel-luxe.
forbidden_inline: decorative icon row without lived-in scene

lived_in_room.utility: Realistic sofa, kitchen nook, clean bedding — lived-in, not catalog luxury

guest_checkin_scene.label_ru: гость у двери / с телефоном / код доступа
guest_checkin_scene.utility: Scene matches H2 about check-in, keys, messenger — people-by-topic OK

comfort_plus_interior.utility: Towels, clean kitchen, Wi-Fi sticker, shoe rack — ordinary guest comfort

labeled_checklist.utility: Named guest questions — not generic «7 советов» decorative

comparison_table.utility: Two columns that differ — deposit, check-in, support

process_flow.utility: Numbered steps: book → instruction → door — one failure point
